roadmap.subject: T1 roadmap review — I need your input
roadmap.m1:
Hi Alex,

We're freezing the Q1 roadmap on Friday. Before that, I'd like your feedback on three points:

1. The timeline for the mail client revamp (beta release end of February?)
2. The trade-off between offline sync and full-text search
3. The design workload for keyboard shortcuts

I've attached version 3 of the document.

Thanks in advance,
Camille
roadmap.re: Re: T1 roadmap review — I need your input
roadmap.m2:
Hi Camille,

I'll look at it this afternoon. On point 2, I think we can ship everything: search is already indexed locally (FTS5), offline sync is the real topic.

I'll send detailed feedback before 5 pm.

Alex

> Hi Alex,
> We're freezing the Q1 roadmap on Friday.
roadmap.m3:
Perfect, thanks!

Thomas is in copy: he can review the technical part in parallel. If you could also add an estimate in days for the MCP server, it would help me for Thursday's presentation.

Camille

> I'll send detailed feedback before 5 pm.
> Alex

newsletter.subject: The Morning Letter: is AI in the mailbox really useful?
newsletter.title: AI in the mailbox: gimmick or real revolution?
newsletter.lead: Automatic summaries, suggested replies, smart sorting… Mail clients have become the first testing ground for agents. But who really controls what the agent reads — and sends — on your behalf?
newsletter.intro: In this issue: the MCP protocol explained simply, three open-source tools to try this week, and why the content of an email should always be treated as untrusted.
